card.name: Surgery and imaging hold instructions
card.fires_on: Words in instructions to stop or hold a drug before surgery or imaging, mainly "contrast" after "iodinated" and "prolonged" or "with" before "fasting".

modes.label: Iodinated contrast
modes.description: The word contrast in the phrase about stopping metformin products before iodinated contrast imaging.
modes.example: agliflozin and metformin hydrochloride extended-release tablets may need to be discontinued at time of, or prior to, iodinated<< contrast>> imaging procedures.

modes.label: Surgery and fasting
modes.description: Words in the phrase about surgery or procedures associated with prolonged fasting.
modes.example: liflozin and Metformin HCl extended-release tablets for at least 3 days, if possible, prior to surgery or procedures associated with<< prolonged>> fasting.

modes.label: Other procedure wording
modes.description: Scattered words in procedure or testing sentences, such as a baseline ECG and evaluation or x-ray.
modes.example: Perform a baseline ECG<< and>> evaluation of LVEF prior to initiating
